title: Titania — Goddess of the Dürrenberg Woods
summary: Sacrifice and regrow lands so Titania manifests the Dürrenberg woods as a visible army of Elemental spirits.

tags.name: lands
tags.reason: Lands die, return, animate, and form the deck's primary resource and win condition.

tags.name: sacrifice
tags.reason: Fetches, outlets, and ramp spells deliberately put lands into the graveyard.

tags.name: graveyard
tags.reason: Loam, Crucible, Ramunap, Six, World Shaper, and Reclamation regrow the domain.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: Titania's 5/3 Elemental tokens are the main clock and card-draw engine.

tags.name: elementals
tags.reason: Titania, Ashaya, Multani, Liege, and the 5/3 army embody the living woods.

tags.name: landfall
tags.reason: Tracker, Baru, the Satchel, and repeated land returns reward land entries.

tags.name: midrange
tags.reason: The deck develops mana and recursion before presenting telegraphed combat.

tags.name: ramp
tags.reason: Druids, auras, and sacrifice-ramp bring a five-mana commander online.

tags.name: aggro
tags.reason: Combat closes games, but only after a midrange land engine develops.
